reason: Guarantee artifact-only handoff to the next Muon pair when the legacy recovery state has no code-level controller heartbeat or lease.
takeover_gate: Both current runs must pass the existing deep completion audit. Then wait the full grace period and require both declared successor log/output artifact sets to remain absent. Recheck immediately before takeover; any successor artifact causes the guard to yield or fail closed.
claim_boundary: This is an operational availability guard. It neither evaluates nor changes a checkpoint and cannot strengthen a scientific claim. It must never inspect, read, edit, signal, stop, replace, or otherwise touch gpu.py or its processes.
